description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

We are actively seeking a Senior Customer Architect with an understanding of technology and hands-on experience in key IT domains, notably Observability, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Search. You should possess a strong technical background, preferably with experience in cloud-based software solutions.

We value individuals who are passionate about staying at the forefront of technology trends with a growth mindset and excited to learn and implement new technologies. While previous experience with Elastic solutions is not a prerequisite, an eagerness to adopt our suite of solutions and apply them effectively to solve our customers' challenges is critical. This key role involves not only driving the consumption of our Elastic solutions by aligning them with customer business objectives but also onboarding customers, securing adoption, and facilitating expansion.

What is The Role

As a Sr Customer Architect, you will be the Trusted Technical Advisor, working in tandem with the customer and complementary groups like Field and Services Teams to ensure that Elastic solutions are exceeding customer's expectations. . Your technical expertise, eye for business, and ability to deliver value will accelerate and improve the customer experience leading to customer continued satisfaction and expansion within the elastic portfolio.

In your role, a crucial part of your responsibility is defining and communicating the technical success criteria for our customers. This involves crafting detailed Technical Success Plans tailored to the specific customers goals and critical metrics.

The Technical Success Plans act as a roadmap, outlining the optimal consumption and deployment of Elastic solutions in the customer's environment. They detail the necessary steps for implementation, highlight achievements for successful consumption or expansion, and provide and effectiveness aligned to the customer's business goals. By actioning this plan , you will be seen as the trusted advisor, guiding the customer towards achieving their desired outcomes, thereby ensuring their success and satisfaction.

From providing technical guidance and sharing standard methodologies to aligning technical objectives with the customers' business goals, your work is instrumental in facilitating smooth adoption, sustained usage, and increased consumption of our solutions. This hands-on role requires you to be proactive, with a keen understanding of our customers' technical landscape and a commitment to making their journey with Elastic solutions successful and valuable.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Your chief aim will be to ensure the customer derives significant value, eliminate technical frictions, and propel the uptake and application of Elastic solutions, with the ultimate goal of growing annual recurring revenue (ARR).
  • Collaborate closely with the account team, including the Account Executive and the Solutions Architect (Pre-sales engineer), to provide ongoing technical coverage and support, while the account team focuses on identifying new deals.
  • Define the technical success plan for each customer, outlining the optimal use of Elastic solutions to achieve their business objectives.
  • Ensure a successful technical customer journey, from onboarding to adoption, while continuously driving the consumption of Elastic solutions.
  • Understand and articulate the value proposition of Elastic solutions and align them with the customer's business goals.
  • Work closely with customers to identify and eliminate technical frictions, promoting a smoother adoption and implementation of Elastic solutions.
  • Liaise between customers and support , as necessary, to ensure an optimized support resolution experience smoothing the adoption curve for the customer.
  • As a hands-on technical authority, collaborate with the Service Team to deliver personalized, frictionless solutions that meet the unique needs of each customer.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the customer's business needs and translate these into technical requirements for Elastic solutions.
  • Find opportunities for expansion, at which point the account team takes over to expand the subscription, aiming to grow annual recurring revenue (ARR).
  • Foster ongoing customer relationships, ensuring that customers continue to increase their utilization of Elastic solutions, further driving ARR.
  • Continuously review and assess customer consumption of Elastic solutions, proactively suggesting upgrades and enhancements that increase value and drive further consumption.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field highly preferred.
  • Validated experience in a similar role such as Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, or Pre-sales Engineer, with hands-on experience with Elastic solutions or equivalent technologies.
  • Experienced with one or more Elastic solutions (Observability, Security, Enterprise Search) or the Elastic stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) and how to align them with business objectives is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong social skills, with the ability to establish relationships with customers and team members.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills, with a track record of delivering innovative solutions.
  • Ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

Elastic is on a mission to make data work for everyone. Our Search AI Platform powers mission-critical solutions across Enterprise Search, Observability, and Security, helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

As buying behaviors evolve and AI fundamentally changes how customers discover, evaluate, and purchase technology, we're reimagining how digital experiences and integrated campaigns accelerate business growth.

We are seeking a transformational Senior Director, Demand and Digital Marketing to redefine customer engagement, demand creation, and revenue growth at Elastic in the AI era. Moving beyond basic program optimization, you will shape our digital strategy, modernize the marketing operating model, and build an AI-enabled organization that delivers measurable business impact.

As a senior member of the Marketing Leadership Team reporting into the CMO, you'll lead a global organization of experienced marketing leaders while partnering closely with Product Marketing, Web, Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership to influence GTM strategy and accelerate pipeline growth.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Digital Strategy & Demand Generation: Execute Elastic's global digital strategy across paid media, integrated campaigns, and lifecycle email marketing. Build an AI-powered, automated demand engine using predictive analytics to maximize pipeline across channels, replacing legacy approaches with data-driven experiences that improve customer engagement, pipeline velocity, and marketing efficiency.
  • Digital Experience & Marketing Innovation: Lead the evolution of Elastic's digital presence from awareness to conversion, optimizing interactions through personalization, AI, and continuous testing. Champion emerging marketing technologies and automation to accelerate campaign execution, enhance customer journeys, and enable real-time organizational decisions.
  • Integrated Campaigns & GTM Partnership: Lead Elastic's end-to-end integrated campaign strategy for Search AI, Observability, and Security solutions. Align full-funnel programs with GTM priorities and customer journeys to resonate with developers and technical decision-makers. Partner cross-functionally with Brand, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure digital investments support business goals.
  • Customer Marketing: Champion the voice of Elastic's existing customer base across digital and campaign channels. Partner with Renewals, Customer Success and Product to develop lifecycle programs, expansion campaigns, and advocacy initiatives that deepen retention, accelerate upsell, and turn customers into vocal champions of Elastic's solutions.
  • Leadership & Organizational Excellence: Lead and develop a global organization of marketing leaders responsible for Digital, Paid Media, Campaigns, Email Marketing, and Lifecycle Marketing. Build leadership capability, strengthen organizational design, and establish operating rhythms that enable high-performing teams to execute at scale. Foster a culture built on innovation, experimentation, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Cross-Functional GTM Partnership: Serve as the leader for Digital & Campaigns within Elastic's broader GTM organization. Partner closely with Brand, Product Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to ensure digital investments directly support business priorities and revenue growth.
  • Performance, Analytics & Investment Strategy: Own the measurement framework connecting digital engagement to business outcomes. Define key KPIs—from acquisition to pipeline and revenue—using data to guide investments, prioritize opportunities, and improve performance. Manage and optimize global digital marketing budgets to maximize growth, efficiency, and business impact.

  • Success in Your First 12 Months

    • Modernize Elastic's global digital and campaign operating model.
    • Build an AI-enabled marketing organization that scales faster and more efficiently.
    • Increase digital contribution to pipeline, revenue, and marketing efficiency.
    • Strengthen alignment across Digital, Product/Field Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations.
    • Develop a high-performing team with clear accountability and operational excellence.
    • Establish a culture of experimentation and continuous optimization across digital touchpoints.
    • Optimize the email marketing strategy to drive engagement and conversion.

What You Bring

  • 15+ years leading B2B marketing organizations across digital marketing, integrated campaigns, demand generation, and GTM strategy.
  • 7+ years leading global teams, building high-performing organizations, and developing leadership talent.
  • Proven enterprise SaaS GTM success, with deep knowledge of complex buying journeys, sales motions, and technical/executive marketing.
  • Strong understanding of digital ecosystems, including paid media, martech, analytics, attribution, and AI-enabled marketing.
  • Experience leveraging generative AI, predictive analytics, and automation to enhance marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional executive presence with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving cross-functional global change.
  • Experience managing global digital marketing investments and optimizing multimillion-dollar budgets for growth and efficiency.
  • A builder's mindset biased toward innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement while inspiring others to raise the bar.

title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Data
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are seeking a visionary and execution-focused Senior Director of Enterprise Data to lead the transformation and maturity of our data ecosystem. Having recently scaled to $2 billion in annual revenue, we are actively building the infrastructure, governance, and operational models required to sustain our trajectory to $4 billion and beyond.

In this role, reporting to the CIO, you will own the end-to-end data strategy, evolving our data platform architecture, scaling our Master Data Management (MDM) systems into an active operational hub, and institutionalizing federated data governance. You will bridge the gap between complex engineering and business execution, transforming data from a utility into a high-octane product that powers real-time decision-making, predictive analytics, agentic AI and operational efficiency across the global enterprise.

What You Will Be Doing

Data Strategy & Platform Evolution

  • Architect the Future: Design, execute, and evolve a scalable data platform roadmap capable of handling a multi-billion dollar enterprise’s volume, velocity, and variety of data.
  • De-bottleneck Legacy Infrastructure: Transition our centralized pipelines into a modern, decoupled data architecture.
  • Data as a Product: Implement a "Data as a Product" mindset across engineering teams, ensuring datasets have strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs), rigorous uptime, and high catalog discoverability.
  • Streaming & Real-Time Analytics: Drive the evolution from purely batch-oriented processing to real-time event streaming for critical business domains like Engineering, Finance, and Customer Experience.

Enterprise Master Data Management (MDM)

  • Build the Golden Record: Evolve our current cross-referenced registry into a highly integrated, multi-domain operational MDM hub (Customer, Product, Vendor/Supplier).
  • Operational Syncing: Ensure mastered data seamlessly flows bidirectionally between analytic environments and core operational execution systems (ERP, CRM, eCommerce).
  • M&A Readiness: Standardize ingestion frameworks to quickly harmonize data from future acquisitions or new business units without interrupting daily operations.

Data Governance, Quality, & Compliance

  • Federated Governance: Establish an enterprise-wide data governance council. Move governance away from gatekeeping and toward a collaborative data stewardship model owned by business units.
  • Automated Observability: Implement modern, automated data lineage, cataloging, and quality testing tools to monitor data health and proactively catch pipeline degradation before it hits business dashboards.
  • Security & Compliance: Partner with Security and Legal teams to ensure the enterprise data platform natively adheres to global regulatory frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, SOX) through robust RBAC/ABAC and automated data masking.

Team Leadership & Operating Model

  • Scale the Organization: Restructure and grow a high-performing data team consisting of data engineers, MDM specialists, platform architects, and data governance managers.
  • Centralized Infrastructure, Embedded Analytics: Champion a hub-and-spoke operating model, providing a central platform layer while enabling embedded data analysts within business units to move fast safely.
  • Cultivate Data Ops: Instill software engineering rigor into data workflows, including CI/CD deployment pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and comprehensive automated test suites.

What You Bring

  • Proven Scale Experience: Minimum of 12+ years of progressive leadership in data engineering, data architecture, or enterprise data management, with explicit experience inside an organization operating in a B2B environment at a $1B to $5B+ revenue scale.
  • Architectural Fluency: Deep hands-on and strategic familiarity with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, AWS/Azure data suites) and enterprise MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica, Reltio, Semarchy, Profisee).
  • Change Management Mastery: Documented success in leading complex corporate data migrations or massive MDM implementations across multi-business-unit enterprises.
  • Business Acumen: Ability to translate complex technical jargon into clear business value, financial ROI, and strategic alignment for C-suite executives.
  • People Leadership: Minimum of 5 years managing manager-level and architect-level direct reports, with a track record of hiring, mentoring, and retaining top-tier engineering talent.

Bonus Points

  • Experience navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments characterized by rapid organizational restructuring or frequent Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).
  • Expertise in setting up a Data Mesh or federated data architecture in a hybrid or multi-cloud environment.
  • Active engagement or understanding of integrating AI/ML infrastructure readiness into core enterprise data platforms.

The Finance Transformation leader will design, scale, and automate the financial systems and operational processes required to support our Hyperscaler Marketplace business. This role acts as the bridge between Corporate Finance, Sales Operations, and Product Engineering. What You Will Be Doing

  • 1. Marketplace Financial System Architecture
    • Architecture & Scalability: Partner with IT and Product Engineering to design and implement scalable workflows that bridge the gap between hyperscaler portals and core finance systems (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Zuora
    • Automate workflows: Design and implement automated finance workflows to handle complex marketplace transactions, including Private Offers (CPPO/MPPO) and custom metering.
    • Integrate systems: Partner with IT to seamlessly connect Hyperscaler APIs and marketplace management platforms (e.g. Tackle.io) with core finance systems
    • Build data pipelines: Own the financial data model for marketplace transactions, ensuring reliable ingestion of raw billing and disbursement data into reporting warehouses.
    2. Revenue Recognition & Financial Operations
    • Manage compliance: Define financial process standards for deferred revenue, gross-vs-net revenue accounting, and ASC 606 compliance specific to cloud marketplace deductions and listing fees.
    • Streamline reconciliations: Build scalable transaction-level reconciliation models to match hyperscaler disbursements and remittance advices against internal sales contracts.
    • Financial Integrity: Maintain transaction accuracy, ensure marketplace listing fees are accurately tracked, and handle dense, unstructured third-party reseller data
    3. Cross-Functional Program Management
    • Business Model Alignment: Partner with Finance, Product and Partner Operations teams to prepare finance and accounting operations for newly introduced marketplace product offerings
    • Lead change management: Direct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and author Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the finance and accounting teams when launching new marketplace capabilities.

What You Bring

  • Core Finance: 8–10+ years of progressive experience in accounting operations, financial systems, or tech-sector management consulting.
  • Marketplace Exposure: 5+ years of direct experience managing the financial operations, billing infrastructure, or billing reconciliation of apps sold through AWS, GCP, or Azure Marketplaces.
  • Transformation Track Record: Proven experience leading large-scale software integrations or Q2C transformation cycles in a B2B SaaS or enterprise tech environment.
  • Marketplace Tools: Deep familiarity with cloud partner portals (AWS, GCP, Azure) and marketplace monetization middleware (e.g., Tackle.io).
  • ERP & Revenue Systems: Advanced knowledge of enterprise ERP systems and specialized revenue recognition systems (e.g., Zuora RevPro).
  • Data Fluency: Solid proficiency utilizing SQL or Business Intelligence tools to dissect, clear, and transform unstructured billing data

This role is responsible for leading the migration from Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud and being responsible for the end-to-end Quote-to-Cash capability. The manager will ensure that quoting, pricing, contracting, ordering, and billing processes operate optimally and scale with business growth. The role requires close partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, and IT.

  • Experience in Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud architecture.
  • Proven experience in end-to-end Quote-to-Cash implementations (CPQ, Billing, Subscription Management, Revenue Recognition).

  • Translate business and solution requirements into executable engineering work.
  • Manage team capacity and sprint commitments in alignment with Scrum best practices.

  • Define and implement solution roadmaps, integration strategies, and system enhancements.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Sales, Finance, IT, Product) to ensure seamless system adoption.
  • Lead workshops, create solution blueprints, and develop proof-of-concepts for business validation.
  • Manage integrations with ERP, CRM, payment gateways, and third-party applications.
  • Ensure compliance with Salesforce security, data, and integration standards.
  • Mentor and guide development/configuration teams on best practices.
  • Stay updated with Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud releases and recommend continuous improvements.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience with Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud implementations or migrations
  • Strong understanding of Quote-to-Cash processes and cross-functional dependencies
  • Ability to lead sophisticated system initiatives with multiple stakeholders
  • Comfortable operating at the intersection of business process and technical design

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

At Elastic, our Corporate Marketing Team designs and executes best-in-class events and experiences that establish Elastic as a trusted advisor to the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Strategic Events Senior Manager to own our third-party conference portfolio globally. A collaborative team player with big ideas and the discipline to execute every detail, you'll be the driving force behind how Elastic shows up at the industry events that matter most — from sponsorship strategy through on-site delivery.

This role is based in North America, with greater priority given to candidates within the United States.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Third-party event strategy: Develop and own a long-range strategy for Elastic's presence at external conferences, tradeshows, and partner events — tied directly to business priorities. Make deliberate, data-informed decisions about where we invest, at what tier, and why, ensuring every sponsorship earns its place in the portfolio.
  • End-to-end execution: Lead every phase of the third-party event lifecycle — from sponsorship evaluation and contract negotiation through booth build, on-site management, and post-event analysis — with the logistics rigor that separates a good event from a great one.
  • Cross-functional alignment: Partner with marketing, sales, and field teams to connect conference programs to pipeline goals. Serve as the connective tissue between sponsorship investment and measurable sales outcomes.
  • Vendor & agency management: Own relationships with event agencies, exhibit houses, and service providers. Negotiate contracts through Procurement, securing competitive terms and all required InfoSec and privacy approvals.
  • Budget & ROI: Build and manage the third-party events budget with a cost-effective mindset. Define success metrics up front, track ROI and engagement, and use those insights to continuously improve portfolio decisions.
  • Risk management: Anticipate what can go wrong before it does. Build contingency plans so the team is never caught off guard — whether it's a last-minute venue change or an on-site logistics challenge.

What You Bring

  • Proven Expertise: 10+ years in B2B event marketing with a focus on third-party conference and tradeshow programs, including a track record of owning sponsorship portfolios from strategy through measurement.
  • Executive presence: Comfortable presenting sponsorship strategy and investment rationale to senior leadership, and skilled at translating vision into detailed execution plans.
  • Sales partnership DNA: You understand pipeline, know how conference presence connects to revenue, and have worked closely with field sales and SDR teams to create and accelerate opportunities at events.
  • Operational excellence: The organizational habits, vendor management expertise, and budget discipline to run a complex multi-event calendar without things falling through the cracks.
  • Data fluency: You evaluate sponsorship tiers objectively, define ROI criteria upfront, and use post-event findings to make smarter portfolio investments each cycle.
  • Adaptability: You thrive managing competing priorities across a fast-paced environment, staying calm when plans change and solutions-oriented when they do.
  • Travel: Up to 40% travel, and managing a remote schedule.

What is The Role

Elastic is looking for a Sr. Salesforce Engineer & Dev Ops Specialist who combines deep architectural intuition, clean coding, and sharp debugging skills with an AI-native workflow (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex). You will serve as the technical backbone of our Salesforce ecosystem—owning the release lifecycle, managing GitHub administration, git automation, and CI/CD pipelines, while facilitating engineering practices across Certinia PSA, CPQ/ARM, AI initiatives, and cross-functional enterprise projects. Balancing hands-on platform development with release engineering, you will streamline revenue processes and scale architecture to deliver high-quality, reliable production solutions.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Dev Ops & Release Engineering: Lead end-to-end Dev Ops operations, including GitHub administration, git automation, branching strategies, CI/CD pipeline optimization, scratch org/sandbox management, backup strategies, and release governance.
  • Full-Stack Salesforce Development: Design and build full-stack features—UI, APIs, business logic, data models, and integrations—using LWC, Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, and modern REST/event-driven patterns.
  • Core Business Platforms: Drive technical design and development across Certinia PSA, CPQ/ARM, and cross-functional enterprise initiatives.
  • AI-Native Engineering: Utilize AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot) throughout the SDLC while maintaining strict oversight, code quality, and security on AI outputs.
  • Quality & Deployment Control: Establish robust deployment gates and build telemetry to monitor pipeline efficiency and release health.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 5+ years of full-stack software engineering experience across frontend, backend, APIs, and data modeling.
  • Salesforce & Dev Ops Depth: Proven expertise in Salesforce platform development alongside deep experience managing Git workflows, advanced git automation, branching strategies, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipelines for enterprise deployments.
  • AI Tooling: Daily proficiency using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate scaffolding, refactoring, and debugging.
  • Architecture & Delivery: Solid knowledge of software design patterns, SDLC, sandbox lifecycle management, and metadata deployment mechanics.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

Bonus Points

  • Specialized Tools: Hands-on experience with native Salesforce DevOps platforms (Copado, Gearset)
  • Domain Expertise: Practical experience developing or administering Certinia PSA, Salesforce CPQ, and/or Revenue Cloud (ARM).
  • Certifications: Salesforce Development Lifecycle and Deployment Architect. Also required are Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Platform Administrator I, Platform Administrator II, Platform App Builder, Copado, and Certinia PSA Administrator.
  • Mindset: An AI-native, adaptable engineer who thrives on solving complex architectural puzzles and elevating team engineering standards.

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. What is the Role:

Elastic is building a dedicated AI Native Accounts organization focused on partnering with the world's most innovative AI companies. We are seeking an extraordinary Strategic Account Executive to help define how the next generation of AI companies build, scale, and innovate using the Elastic Search AI Platform. This is one of the most strategic individual contributor roles at Elastic.
Rather than managing a broad territory, you will own a highly selective portfolio of globally strategic AI-native customers. You will work directly with executive and technical leaders to help solve some of the industry's most complex AI, search, and data challenges while accelerating adoption of the Elastic Search AI Platform. Success in this role extends well beyond revenue attainment. You will serve as a trusted advisor, develop long-term executive relationships, influence product strategy through customer insight, and play a meaningful role in one of Elastic's highest-priority growth initiatives.
 
Location: West of Texas
 
Organizational Scope
Each Strategic Account Executive is responsible for a small number of globally strategic AI-native customers. Rather than broad geographic coverage, this organization is intentionally designed around depth of engagement, executive relationships, technical credibility, and long-term strategic partnerships.
This role works closely with Solutions Architecture, Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Strategic Alliances, and Executive Leadership to deliver extraordinary customer outcomes while helping shape Elastic's leadership in the AI ecosystem.

What You'll Do:

  • Own Strategic Customer Relationships: Develop trusted relationships with founders, CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, AI research leaders, engineering executives, and senior technical stakeholders across a focused portfolio of AI-native organizations. Become a strategic advisor by understanding each customer's business priorities, AI initiatives, and long-term technology strategy.
  • Drive Complex Enterprise Sales Cycles: Lead sophisticated enterprise sales opportunities from discovery through executive alignment, commercial negotiation, procurement, and successful adoption. Navigate complex buying environments while creating alignment across technical, business, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop Executive Account StrategiesBuild comprehensive account plans that identify executive sponsors, technical champions, whitespace opportunities, competitive positioning, ecosystem partners, and long-term expansion strategies designed to maximize customer success and business growth.
  • Partner Across the AI Ecosystem: Collaborate with cloud providers, hyperscalers, AI platform companies, strategic technology partners, and systems integrators to develop scalable sell-with strategies that accelerate customer adoption and strengthen Elastic's position within the AI ecosystem.
  • Influence Product Strategy: Serve as the voice of the customer by partnering closely with Product Management and Engineering. Deliver meaningful market intelligence and customer feedback that helps shape the future of the Elastic Search AI Platform.
  • Deliver Predictable Business Results: Consistently achieve and exceed revenue objectives through disciplined account planning, pipeline management, accurate forecasting, opportunity inspection, and operational excellence.

What You Bring:

  • Enterprise Sales Excellence: A proven track record of consistently exceeding quota while managing complex enterprise software sales cycles involving executive stakeholders, technical decision-makers, and global organizations.
  • AI & Modern Infrastructure Expertise: Strong understanding of today's AI landscape, including large language models (LLMs), AI infrastructure, developer platforms, cloud-native architectures, modern data platforms, and enterprise AI adoption. Comfortable engaging in strategic technical conversations with engineering and AI leaders.
  • Executive Presence: Demonstrated success building trusted relationships with founders, C-level executives, engineering leaders, and technical decision-makers. Skilled at influencing strategic business outcomes through executive engagement and value-based selling.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop long-term account strategies, identify growth opportunities, navigate complex organizations, and execute against multi-year customer plans.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, and Strategic Alliances to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
  • Operational Excellence: Highly disciplined with expertise in account planning, forecasting, pipeline management, executive inspection, and structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC.
  • Experience selling AI infrastructure, enterprise search, cloud platforms, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, data platforms, or enterprise software into strategic enterprise accounts.
  • Experience working with AI-native organizations, hyperscalers, or other high-growth technology companies.
  • Existing executive relationships across the AI ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with open-source software, developer-first go-to-market strategies, and product-led growth (PLG).
  • Experience managing highly strategic, complex, multi-year enterprise opportunities.

title: Tech Lead, Agent Framework - Observability
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elastic's Streams program is the unified platform for getting data into Elasticsearch from edge collection all the way through cloud processing. At the edge, Elastic Agent and Beats are how data leaves customer infrastructure. 

This role is the tech lead position for the Agent Framework team: you will own the architecture, set the technical direction, and be the primary decision-maker for how Elastic's agent layer evolves to support the Streams model.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design a scalable and capable architecture for the agent layer. Evaluate and implement new technologies to boost system performance. Conduct reviews of existing architecture to identify areas for improvement and lead architectural discussions to drive decision-making.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to team members while fostering a culture of continuous learning. Conduct code reviews and offer constructive feedback to improve team performance. Lead by example, demonstrating engineering best practices and setting high standards for quality.
  • Engage with stakeholders to gather their requirements and expectations appropriately. Collaborate with the product management team to prioritize features based on the input gathered from stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration across teams by organizing meetings and coordinating efforts. Identify potential risks that could hinder project success and take initiative-taking measures to mitigate them. Adjust project plans in response to changing priorities or feedback from stakeholders to ensure alignment.

What You Bring 

  • Proven experience as a technical lead or principal engineer on an agent, daemon, or systems-level software project at scale managing distributed deployments, versioning, and backward compatibility.
  • Deep knowledge of observability data collection: metrics, logs, traces, and the protocols that carry them (OTLP, Prometheus Remote Write, syslog, etc.).
  • Solid background in Go (Elastic Agent and Beats are primarily Go).
  • Experience designing management and control planes for distributed software   particularly protocol-driven approaches like OpAMP.
  • Track record of leading large, multi-team technical initiatives from ambiguous design space to shipped software.
  • Proven ability to seamlessly transition between different projects and codebases, and work with different teams based on dynamic business priorities.
  • Comfortable with the full arc of a technical decision: writing the design doc, socializing it across stakeholders, building consensus, and holding the line on what matters.
  • Great written communication you produce design docs and ADRs that others trust and reference long after the decision is made

Bonus Points

  • Direct experience with Elastic Agent, Fleet, Beats, or OpenTelemetry collector internals.
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry collector configuration, OTLP transport, or upstream contribution.
  • Experience with cross platform testing and developer productivity spanning all of Linux, Windows, MacOS, containers, and Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge about pipeline execution models and processing languages (Streamlang, Logstash, Fluent, etc.).
  • Experience with CloudFormation, Terraform, or other infrastructure-as-code tooling in the context of agent deployment.
  • Contributions to open source projects in the observability or agent ecosystem.
  • Comfort working async-first across a globally distributed team.

  • Experience with CloudFormation, Terraform, or other infrastructure-as-code tooling in the context of agent deployment.

What is The Role

We are hiring a solid Corporate Counsel, with 4+ years’ experience, to join our expanding International Commercial Legal department in this fast growing, truly globally distributed company. Reporting to the UK & Emerging Region Legal Director, this position will be ideal for a self-sufficient and resourceful mid-level attorney located in the United Kingdom.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Responsible for managing the full legal lifecycle of our Public Sector contracts (including Cloud/SaaS and Software Subscription agreements, Professional Services agreements, Data Processing Agreements and associated schedules ensuring compliance with UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018, etc) — from early-stage bid support and framework call-off negotiations through to contract execution and ongoing contract management — while advising internally on the regulatory and compliance obligations that come with supplying cloud services to the Public Sector.
  • Support the Sales & RFP Teams during live procurement processes, reviewing ITT/RFP requirements, drafting legal responses, and advising on terms and conditions proposed by contracting authorities.
  • Engage closely with Elastic’s UK Legal Director based in France and Elastic’s Security Controller, based in the United Kingdom, the wider Legal Department spread across the USA, EMEA and APJ and Elastic’s go-to-market stakeholders e.g. finance and compliance organization. 
  • Supporting EMEA & Global Legal team members on ad hoc projects – as directed.
  • Keeping abreast of relevant legal and regulatory developments and proactively advising the business on their implications.
  • Help to build and strengthen workflow processes between the Legal Department and other departments within Elastic to enable dealmaking and compliance initiatives. This includes leaning into AI tools and automation opportunities.

What You Bring

  • You are qualified and legally permitted to practice law in the United Kingdom and have 4+ years’ experience in the drafting and negotiation of technology contracts (including Cloud/SaaS and Software Subscription agreements, Professional Services agreements, Data Processing Agreements) with Public Sector customers.
  • Strong working knowledge of public procurement law, public law principles, and contract law, together with an understanding of cyber and information security obligations in technology contracts, and the ability to engage credibly with technical and security teams (including requirements for Cyber Essentials / Cyber Essentials Plus certification, ISO 27001 compliance, and alignment with NCSC guidance).
  • Experience & knowledge of relevant laws and legal systems in key regions such as the United Kingdom, France, Australia and Germany. 
  • You will have the ability to balance legal risks with business strategy.
  • Candidates who have prior experience managing technology contracts for public sector entities, whether in-house in the private sector, or with a central government department, local authority, or regulated public sector organisation, are preferred.
  • You thrive while independently running your own time in a demanding, fast-paced environment, are able to handle ambiguity and rapidly shifting priorities with flexibility, patience, and humour.

Bonus Points

  • A self-starter by nature - you have the proven track history to balance multiple projects and recalibrate advice in view of shifting priorities, legal developments, and risk tolerance.

  • Experience with, or at least a good working knowledge of, complex software licensing and cloud business models and related legal issues.

  • Demonstrated ability to consistently deliver outstanding results.

  • Familiarity with data protection and privacy issues and concerns in the context of technology transactions, as a significant plus.

  • Prior experience representing high-growth companies is strongly preferred.

  • Ability to collaborate and function well in a distributed team environment.

  • Ability to participate in some limited travel requirements.

  • Written and spoken English.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.

  • Lead our video strategy and oversee end-to-end production.
  • Manage an internal team of a video editor and motion graphics animator, with external vendors for scale as needed.
  • Produce scalable video content ranging from polished launches to fast-turn social (LinkedIn, X, YouTube) and remote recordings.
  • Serve as producer, creative lead, and hands-on editor when needed.

  • Review and provide feedback on all videos to ensure they meet Elastic’s standards for quality, accuracy, and brand consistency.
  • Partner with stakeholders to tell compelling stories that simplify complex technology.

  • Advanced editing skills and willingness to jump into projects when needed.
  • Experience creating high-quality content with lean budgets and small teams.
  • Ability to translate technical topics into engaging video.
  • Excellent project management and collaboration skills.
  • A builder's mindset—you thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy creating new ways of working.

title: VP, Product Marketing, Observability
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are looking for an outstanding leader to helm our Observability Product Marketing team. In this role, you will be a trusted partner to the company and product leadership, working closely on defining the marketing, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for Elastic Observability SREs and decision makers. To be successful you will have a history of leading teams to achieve outstanding results. You should have deep technical understanding of Observability solutions (being a former practitioner is a plus) with a nuanced understanding of the Observability market technologies and competitive dynamics. Additionally, you should be adept at the creative aspects of positioning technology through messaging and narratives that are compelling, authentic, and differentiated!

What You Will Be Doing

  • Provides thought leadership around market trends and competing solutions
  • Brings excellent leadership and teamship to the company, interfaces effectively with Leadership, Product, Sales and Marketing
  • Leads a growing Observability PMM team, including hiring and development of talent
  • Set the Observability marketing strategy — including messaging, technical content, priorities, field enablement, and GTM
  • Clearly articulates Elastic’s position and differentiation vs similar offerings. Be the expert on competitive capabilities.
  • Create, curate and present compelling content for consumption on the web, press releases, executive briefings, blogs and sales enablement
  • Is the expert on target personas and segments, how customers buy and users adopt our products, and the value they derive from them
  • Represent the company at various speaking engagements, conferences and press interviews
  • Act as a technical product marketing lead for Elastic Observability
  • Serve as an internal authority on the developer and SRE personas

What You Will Bring

Being successful will require you to bring Observability domain expertise. Familiarity with Elastic products is a plus. We would love to hear from you, if you have:
  • Well respected leader who has built, scaled, and lead global teams of 5 - 15 people
  • Several years experience creating outbound messaging and content that resonates with a technical SRE audience
  • Creative energy, courage to throw out the playbook, and out of the box thinking
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Technical depth with respect to our products, solutions and industries we play in and capable of learning quickly. Ability to be hands-on with the product (former practitioner a plus).
  • Comfortable working in a cross-functional role with a highly distributed team

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
